Jan 2017 • Family
This place is terrible, beyond terrible. I can honestly say it's the worst dining experience I've ever had, the staff are beyond useless - they spend most of their time sitting around gossiping, play fighting and chasing each other around the restaurant, this all sounds like a joke but it isn't. We were brought too few knives for our steak and then after asking repeatedly and told to "wait" the waiter ran off to play fight with the other staff. Our bill was about 2.5 million dong, we refused to pay 30,000 dong for 10 wet wipes which we assumed were complimentary (we found this out after translating the bill from Vietnamese) after ordering seafood. They gathered around in a threatening posy waiting for us to pay the bill. We requested to see the manager to sort this out no less than 10 times until he magically appeared when we left the bill minus the wet wipe amount. He was worse than them all. They started grabbing us and blocking our path over the remaining 30k dong. Eventually we decided that becoming Rocky Balboa over 30k dong wasn't worth it and we relunctantly paid, long story short if you're looking for a fight come to this restaurant and if you and looking for a nice relaxing meal avoid it at all costs.

Worst restaurant experience
Jan 2017 • Family
I would not even restrict my review to restaurants in Vietnam - this restaurant has the most ill mannered, poor service that I have ever experienced. I understand that you should not necessarily come into a foreign country expecting service staff to speak English, however the staff at Pho Bien could barely understand (or chose not to understand) even basic words or gestures. They were extremely unfriendly, rude, and unprofessional, forgetting to provide us with cutlery, and "play fighting" with each other in the middle of the restaurant instead of fetching it after having been asked several times. 

This restaurant (and this is the only time I have ever experienced this) charged us for hand towels which were:

- not listed as being a chargeable item on the menu;
- used at a 'seafood' restaurant to clean up after eating shellfish; and
- insufficient to be used multiple times for meals which tend to be quite messy. 

The manager of the restaurant was perhaps the worst of the service staff. When we were questioning the bill, he refused to even engage in dialogue, and made threatening gestures, calling people from nearby stores to stand behind him to intimidate us as we queried the bill. 

To describe this restaurant as deplorable is an understatement. Please, please stay away!
